title: Assumption
description: One row of an assumption register (forecast or capacity plan). Every assumption is graded, says where it came from, whether it persists, and what observation would change it.

name.description: Short name, e.g. chat effective concurrency, East region

value.description: The assumed value with its unit, or a range when grade is E.

definition_ref.description: Metric the assumption is about, if any

carried_from.description: Where the value came from. 'measured' means from this book's ledger; anything carried from another book, era, platform or channel is named here and cannot be graded M.

structural_or_transitional.description: structural: persists into steady state and belongs in the capacity plan · transitional: passes and belongs in the short-term forecast only.

what_would_change_it.description: The observation, and its threshold, that would revise this assumption

sensitivity.description: Effect on the output of moving the assumption across its range, e.g. ±4% requirement hours

owner.description: One role or name; never a team

first_used_in.description: Forecast or plan version where it first appeared
